narrative: The only suppliers that presently meet the eligibility criteria are **Bold‑Cipher‑3FA8** (100 % quality‑ratio, 1 040 exchange points, eligible = True) and **Grave‑Forge‑14DA** (90 % quality‑ratio, 155 exchange points, eligible = True). Although **Wild‑Bastion‑79A8** and **Stone‑Anchor‑A7F1** boast the highest exchange points (≈ 17 800) and a solid 95 % quality‑ratio, both are flagged **eligible = False**, so buyers should treat them with caution. The mid‑tier providers **Keen‑Cipher‑FDDC** and **Keen‑Vault‑96DD** show a lower 66 % quality‑ratio and are also ineligible. All four actors listed under “SCAMS / BAD ACTORS” – **Bold‑Rampart‑E437**, **Deep‑Ridge‑1577**, **Iron‑Beacon‑F731**, and **Quiet‑Gate‑7759** – have incurred high‑severity slashes (loss of 10 % of staked assets) and must be avoided. In summary, fleet health is mixed: a couple of high‑quality, eligible suppliers are available, but a sizable segment of large‑volume but ineligible providers and several confirmed scam nodes require heightened vigilance.
